assets.prompt: Create a NEW redesigned rare sea crocodile aquarium game thumbnail, not a repeat of the old curled squat crocodile. One olive-green sea crocodile, cream belly, simple large teal green scales and low rounded dorsal ridges, elongated streamlined swimming body, long tail extends behind horizontally with only gentle curve, four short legs tucked back naturally, cheerful intelligent face, no jewelry. Head and long snout face SCREEN RIGHT, tail trails LEFT. Clear side profile, whole animal visible, horizontal head-body baseline, no curled-up tail, no large vertical arch. Occupy 85% of square canvas width, centered, body height about 32% of canvas, transparent background actual alpha, no floor, no shadows, no text, no UI.

Edit ONLY the framing/margins of this transparent square 2x2 sprite sheet. KEEP character design, right-facing orientation, colors, all four subtly different tail poses, crisp edges, and real transparent alpha background. Current crocodiles almost touch the left/right cell boundaries. Make each crocodile SMALLER by factor 0.84 within its existing square cell, using exactly the SAME scale for all four cells, then put each animal's head/rigid body on the SAME cell-relative coordinates. All four animals comfortably fit, including toes and tail.
